comparison.objective: Pull two snap-fit case halves apart and leave them separated; candidate adjusts and locks damper behavior through iterative physical test cycles.
comparison.physical_skill: Case opening tests bimanual opposing pulls sufficient to overcome a spring-plunger detent while controlling both halves. Candidate tests small-tool alignment, counterholding, fastener release and locking, fine collar rotation, physical control operation, and response-based adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Board task scores progressive separation past the detent and full release, culminating in flat, still halves separated by at least 3 cm for 1 s. Candidate succeeds only after two compliant stops within specified dynamic and retention limits, with unsafe energized adjustment or hard-stop impact scoring zero.
comparison.reason: Bimanual stabilization is only a generic shared primitive. Detent separation of a housing does not test parameter tuning, tool-mediated locking, or validation of dynamic energy absorption.
